# Draft:2030 South Korean Presidental election

The 2030 South Korean Presidental election will be held on an undetermined date in 2030. The South Korean Constution limits Presidents to one five year term. Due to this restrictation. Incumbent President. Lee Jae Myung Is ineligible to seek a second term. Since democracy in South Korea. This will be the tenth Presidental election. The previous election Saw Democratic Party candidate win over ppp candidate Kim moon soo.
References
Lee Jae myung has supported a change to south Koreas constitution. To allow Presidents to serve Two four year terms.Due to this It is uncertain If there still is a one term Presidental limit.
